thesis: Broad growth supports durability while the 38.15x multiple requires a longer growth bridge. Both cases leave the justified premium unresolved.
strongest_counterexample: Double-digit growth across products and geographies plus strong cash generation make the premium more credible than a single-cycle story.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of negative year-on-year EPS growth.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of EPS growth above 15% with positive FCF growth.
evidence_gaps: Multi-quarter normalized growth and current cash-versus-buyback bridge.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Broad product growth and cash generation support quality
Broad growth across products and regions supports durability more than a single product story
